name: Impetus of Hades
description:
• While sneaking, enemies only detect you while within 10 blocks and facing you.

  • You can double sneak while undetected or out of enemy sight to enter [effect:form][purple]chthonic form[/purple][/effect] for 4 seconds. Strikes that end [purple]chthonic form[purple] critically strike and deal +6♥️ magic damage.

[dark-gray]"Become kin with darkness. Deliver them to me."[/dark-gray]

effects.explanation: Stealth by descending into shadows, gaining +50% speed and +1 step height. Stealths end upon using items or dealing direct damage.
